studios.name: Studio Mabua
studios.notes: Shopify store, prices in NIS. 23 lighting products (plus 2 duplicate Casta listings and a 'Samples of material' item at 660 NIS, both left out). Lead time: made to order, 4-6 weeks for ceramic pieces, 6-8 weeks for wood veneer and floor lamps; FAQ says custom and floor-lamp orders may take longer. Shipping policy: 14-18 business days, Priority Mail door to door, tracking; customs and import tax on the buyer; 'Shipping calculated at checkout' (no rate shown). FAQ: LED bulbs included only for orders within Israel; fixtures are for LED bulbs only; made for 110V or 220V as ordered; 1-year warranty from delivery; indoor only, not for bathrooms or wet areas; custom size, finish and colour accepted (info@studiomabua.com). Returns: contact within 14 days of delivery, ship back within 30 days, buyer pays return shipping; custom orders final unless damaged; cancellation within 24 hours. No ת"י 20, CE or IP rating is stated on any page. Most pages give one 'approx.' size without saying which dimension; the Hebrew pages (/he/products/...) sometimes label diameter/height and sometimes disagree with the English (noted per product). Installation PDFs exist for 7 products; they sometimes give a different max wattage or socket than the page (noted). Cable lengths are never stated.

studios.name: Studio Vayehi
studios.notes: Wix store, prices in ILS with a price per size in the store data. 34 lighting products (each wood is a separate page for ARC, CANOE, LIGHT CLOUD, SHELL, WIND, WING); 2 serving trays left out. Product pages: production up to 3 weeks, shipping within max. 10 days; customs/duties abroad on the buyer. Shipping-policy page: allow 7-14 business days to complete and ship; registered air mail via Israel Post with tracking; Israel up to 5 business days door to door; US 1-2 weeks; Europe and elsewhere 1-3 weeks. Cancellations within 24 hours; returns within 14 days of delivery, buyer pays return shipping, refund excludes shipping. WIND, WING, LIGHT CLOUD and CANOE carry a '15% off at checkout' ribbon (listed prices are before it). Pendants come with a 1.5 m textile cable (CANOE 2 m), socket and ceiling plate; five cable colours. Every page says indoor use only. Voltage is stated only on PLATE; no ת"י 20, CE or IP rating is stated. Contact on site: studiovayehi@gmail.com, HaPelech 7, Tel Aviv-Yafo. Etsy shop (https://www.etsy.com/il-en/shop/StudioVayehi) was not checked: it returned HTTP 403 with a captcha (bot wall), so nothing was taken from Etsy.
